description: Graph-native bridge from a locally verified natural-language InstructionInterpretation to an output-null active generic order-N humanoid mission. The developmental plan remains the only motor authority. Competence confirmation requires a later causally closed embodied receipt and new integer capability success evidence; LLM and other teacher evidence are never authoritative for bodily action.

rules.name: eig_propose_order_n_humanoid_goal_from_locally_verified_instruction
rules.comment: A locally verified imperative authorises an output-null mission, never a motor command. The developmental plan selects every actual capability and action.

parts.value: I have an attached embodied world and am pursuing

rules.name: eig_abstain_when_no_ready_embodied_developmental_capability_exists
rules.comment: A verified instruction without an active or ready graph-selected developmental capability is understood but not enacted.

parts.value: I understood the embodied instruction, but no ready developmental capability is currently available.

rules.name: eig_open_receipt_confirmation_for_proposed_humanoid_goal
rules.comment: Snapshot integer success evidence at proposal time.  A confirmation needs a strictly later observed improvement, not a language-model verdict or an already-held success.

rules.name: eig_mission_supervises_selected_developmental_goal
rules.comment: Natural language sets the mission boundary. The generic developmental plan still chooses the current capability; the mission only adopts that graph-selected goal as an order-N subgoal.

rules.name: eig_renew_supervisory_lease_for_verified_embodied_mission
rules.comment: A verified instruction is top-down evidence that the held embodied frontier is again worth pursuing; it renews the existing process rather than bypassing it.

rules.name: eig_bind_embodied_mission_to_exact_external_trial_request
rules.comment: The root mission retains every distinct post-baseline session request pursuing one of its graph-selected developmental subgoals.  This is an ordered causal provenance set, not a one-shot latch: an early unproductive probe must not sever later competent evidence, and unrelated or historical requests remain inadmissible.

rules.name: eig_bind_embodied_mission_to_exact_causal_trial_receipt
rules.comment: Every exact receipt minted by a mission-bound request remains available as causal provenance.  Confirmation later consumes the first positive receipt, rather than treating an early zero-yield probe as terminal evidence.

rules.name: eig_confirm_goal_only_from_later_closed_embodied_receipt
rules.comment: The confirming datum is the first positive causally bound developmental receipt plus a new capability success unit.  Earlier zero-yield receipts remain inspectable but cannot consume confirmation.  No text, teacher evidence, direct actuator command, or float enters this transition.
